title: 第11章 偷袭第12章 成为首领
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
李秦武收编了烂脸的部队，兵力抵达巅峰，他打算今晚带人回去火拼，在首领杀他之前动手。
为了提升新兵士气，第一顿得吃点好的，他又拿出两个单位的魔兽肉，将其扯成肉条放在篝火边烤，烤好后拿出一袋谷物，用烤肉卷着谷物发给哥布林们吃。
谷物提供的碳水能量很充足，吃这玩意顶饿，但口感不好，哥布林不喜欢，好在用烤肉裹着就没有问题。
部队吃饱后，李秦武让他们每人找了一根又长又平直的木棍，让他们把木棍头部放在篝火里烤，烤到碳化后用石头将头部磨尖做成木矛。
他把装谷物的袋子递给哥布大。
“去摘红毒果，把这个袋子装满！”
哥布大领命跑出去了。
李秦武在新招募的哥布林里找出一个肩膀略宽，手臂略长的，把另一只弓给他。
“从今以后你叫哥布弓，好好看，我教你怎么射箭！”
李秦武手把手教哥布弓射箭，不指望他能射多准，反正这玩意射程只有20米，应用场景几乎是贴脸射。
教了几次，哥布弓差不多能将箭射出去了，只是准头堪忧。
李秦武让他在一边练习，让持矛哥布林集合，他打开战场指挥页面，把所有持矛哥布林编组为持矛步兵，然后让他们列队。
“看好了，跟我一起做这个动作！”
李秦武站在队列前面，拿着根长矛演示捅刺。
哥布林们都模仿他的动作开始捅刺。
这么短的时间，李秦武不指望把他们练成精兵，只要让他们知道怎么把矛尖送出去就行，有骑砍系统可以让他们强制战斗，这就够接下来火并用了。
重哥布林操练了一会儿，或许是有系统加持的原因，他们的动作还挺有模有样，李秦武更有底气了。
半个多小时后，哥布大气喘吁吁跑回来，他手里的袋子装满了红毒果。
一切准备就绪，李秦武拿出烤鱼让众人吃了第2顿饭，然后命令众人原地躺下睡觉。
哥布林一个个倒头就睡，能吃饱就睡，他们感觉自己无比幸福，新老大真是太好了！

时间来到深夜，李秦武将所有哥布林叫醒，现在哥布林部落的家伙们全部睡着了，正是出兵的好时机！
他带着哥布林们悄悄往部落方向走，哥布林们还以为新老大要带他们回去接着睡觉，绝对想不到李秦武接下来要做的事有多疯狂。
不告诉他们要去干嘛，是因为李秦武太了解哥布林了，他们一听要跟首领战斗，肯定会吓得屁滚尿流，会坏事。
不如瞒着他们，把他们拉到战场，直接用系统功能让他们a上去，在所有人反应过来之前把事情做完！
因为哥布林有夜视能力，夜晚行军对他们没什么难度，他们很快摸到哥布林部落外围草丛。
李秦武下令停下，让哥布林们将红毒果捣碎，把汁液均匀涂抹在长矛尖尖上，他一个一个检查过去，确保每只长毛尖都均匀涂抹上了汁液。
一切完成后，他下令让众人站在原地不准出声，他悄悄摸进哥布林部落观察情况。
此时的哥布林部落一切如常，哥布林们随便找块地方趴着就睡，甚至没安排人放哨。
早上烂脸的队伍被他收编，一支狩猎队没回归，愣是没人在意。
尤其是首领，那死胖子就躺在草棚里呼呼大睡，呼噜声和打雷似的，一点没派人出去找的意思。
或许在这家伙看来，手下哥布林都是耗材，缺人了随便从幼崽中滴溜几个喂大，这不又有人来服侍自己了吗。
哥布林只要去死就好了，首领考虑的可就多了，当首领太累了，每天必须保持18小时的睡眠。
月黑风高时，杀人放火天，李秦武不再做任何等待，直接F1选中所有部队，F3发起冲锋！
他一波将手里所有部队a了上去，打算用蚂蚁咬死象的战术弄死这胖子！
李秦武身后的哥布林们正摸不着头脑呢，不知道新任老大为什么在部落门口不进去？突然，他们感觉灵魂仿佛受到了指引，一个个拿着长矛冲了出去。
他们以最快的速度冲进哥布林部落，冲向部落中唯一的建筑小茅草屋。
冲锋的动静惊动了部落里其他哥布林，这些家伙从地上爬起来，一脸懵逼，不知道发生了什么。
李秦武看到自己的19个哥布林矛兵径直冲进茅草屋，他心说大事已成，接下来只要乱矛捅刺，就算你是大哥布林也只有死的份
“桀桀桀桀桀！！”
李秦武开始发癫，都想好控制部落后实行几个5年计划了。

但让他意想不到的是，好一会儿后，什么动静都没有，首领被乱毛捅刺惨叫的情景并没有发生，持矛哥布林们围着首领不知所措。
“卧槽！你们搞什么？！”
这些家伙冲进去不杀人搁那站着看睡美人呢？
此时哥布林首领的鼾声停止，他被惊醒了！
他睁眼就看见一堆小弟围着自己，吓得他嗷的一声嚎叫，直接从地上蹦了起来。
content_en:
Li Qinwu gathered the ruthless troops and reached their peak strength. He planned to take his men back to fight tonight and take action before the leader killed him.
In order to improve the morale of the recruits, they had to eat something good for the first meal. He took out two units of Warcraft meat, cut it into strips and roasted it by the campfire. After roasting, he took out a bag of grains, rolled the grains in the barbecue and distributed them to the goblins.
The carbohydrate energy provided by the grains is sufficient. It makes you hungry when you eat it, but the taste is not good and the goblins don't like it. Fortunately, there is no problem if it is wrapped in barbecue.
After the troops had eaten, Li Qinwu asked each of them to find a long, straight wooden stick, and asked them to roast the head of the stick in the campfire. After roasting until it was carbonized, they sharpened the head with a stone to make a wooden spear.
He handed the bag of grain to Cobuda.
"Go pick red poison fruits and fill this bag!"
Cobuda took the order and ran out.
Li Qinwu found one of the newly recruited goblins with slightly wider shoulders and longer arms, and gave him the other bow.
"From now on, your name is Gob Gong. Look good. I'll teach you how to shoot an arrow!"
Li Qinwu taught Gob how to shoot with a bow step by step. He didn't expect him to be very accurate. Anyway, the range of this thing is only 20 meters, and the application scenario is almost to shoot close to the face.
After teaching it a few times, I can almost shoot arrows with the Gob bow, but its accuracy is worrisome.
Li Qinwu asked him to practice aside and let the spear-wielding goblins gather. He opened the battlefield command page, organized all the spear-wielding goblins into spear-wielding infantry, and then had them line up.
"Watch it, do this move with me!"
Li Qinwu stood in front of the queue and demonstrated stabbing with a spear.
The goblins imitated his movements and started stabbing.
In such a short period of time, Li Qinwu didn't expect to train them into elite soldiers. He just wanted them to know how to send the spear points out. There was a riding and slashing system that could force them to fight, which was enough to use them with fire.
The heavy goblins practiced for a while. Perhaps because of the blessing of the system, their movements were quite impressive, and Li Qinwu felt more confident.
More than half an hour later, Gob came back panting, the bag in his hand filled with red poison berries.
When everything was ready, Li Qinwu took out the grilled fish for everyone to have their second meal, and then ordered everyone to lie down and sleep.
The goblins fell asleep one by one and slept as soon as they had enough to eat. They felt extremely happy. The new boss was really great!
It was late at night, and Li Qinwu woke up all the goblins. Now that all the goblin tribesmen were asleep, it was a good time to send troops!
He led the goblins quietly toward the tribe. The goblins thought that the new boss was going to take them back to sleep, but they never imagined how crazy what Li Qinwu would do next would be.
The reason why he didn't tell them what they were going to do was because Li Qinwu knew the goblins too well. When they heard that they were going to fight the leader, they would definitely be scared to death and do bad things.
It's better to hide it from them, drag them to the battlefield, directly use the system function to let them go up, and finish the matter before everyone reacts!
Because goblins have night vision, marching at night is not difficult for them. They quickly touched the grass outside the goblin tribe.
Li Qinwu ordered to stop and asked the goblins to crush the red poison fruit and apply the juice evenly on the spear tips. He checked them one by one to ensure that each long-haired tip was evenly coated with the juice.
After everything was completed, he ordered everyone to stand still and not make any sound. He quietly sneaked into the Goblin tribe to observe the situation.
At this time, everything in the Goblin tribe was as usual. The Goblins just found a place to lie down and sleep, and no one was even arranged to keep watch.
The bad-looking team in the morning was recruited by him. One hunting team did not return, but no one cared.
Especially the leader, that damn fat guy was lying in the hut sleeping soundly, snoring like thunder, and had no intention of sending anyone out to look for him.
Perhaps in this guy's opinion, the goblins under his command are just consumables.Then he would feed a few of the cubs, and now someone would come to serve him.
Goblins just need to die, but the leader has a lot to think about. Being the leader is too tiring and he must sleep 18 hours a day.
When the moon is dark and the wind is high, there are murders and arson. Li Qinwu does not wait any longer, directly selects all the troops with F1, and launches a charge with F3!
He moved all the troops in his hand up in one wave, intending to kill the fat man with the ant-biting-elephant tactic!
The goblins behind Li Qinwu were scratching their heads. Why didn't the new boss come in at the entrance of the tribe? Suddenly, they felt as if their souls were being guided, and they rushed out one by one with spears.
They rushed into the Goblin tribe as quickly as possible and rushed towards the small thatched house, the only building in the tribe.
The sound of charging alerted the other goblins in the tribe. These guys got up from the ground, looking confused and not knowing what was going on.
Li Qinwu saw his 19 goblin spearmen rushing straight into the thatched house. He thought that the big thing was done. If you are stabbed with spears next time, even if you are a big goblin, you will die.
"Jie Jie Jie Jie Jie!!"
Li Qinwu started to go crazy, thinking about implementing several five-year plans after controlling the tribe.
But what he didn't expect was that after a while, there was no movement. The scene where the leader was stabbed by random hairs and screamed did not happen. The spear-wielding goblins surrounded the leader at a loss.
"Fuck! What are you doing?!"
If these guys don't kill people when they rush in, why not stand and watch Sleeping Beauty?
At this time, the snoring of the Goblin leader stopped, and he was awakened!
When he opened his eyes, he saw a bunch of boys surrounding him. He howled in fright and jumped up from the ground.
